protocol.backend: RAI/FCL, no LD_PRELOAD or experimental native edge checker
protocol.benchmark_note: QP uses current project_feasible; rounded reference uses the frozen fixed-barrier-metric implementation. No historical timings pooled.
protocol.analysis_revision: Existing blog palette restored; selected cache settings included in plot provenance. No measurement code/settings changed.

aggregation: Median and IQR after all seeds solve; thin individual curves. Timeouts retained in fraction-solved denominator. Configured-grid validity only.

selected_settings.rule: Enable if exercised, arithmetic mean iteration-throughput ratio >= 0.95, and total solved count does not decrease. No selection by lowest final cost.
selected_settings.note: A small conservative gate, not a statistical performance claim. Both gate arms remain in the saved results.
